visualCaptureOptOutReason: unpaced throughput/stage leg: the untimed capture tail keeps playing unpaced past the measured window, so its presents count against the header-frame loop check and blur the measured rate
presentTearingExpectedReason: unpaced headroom leg at swap interval 0: every present goes out with SyncInterval 0, so PresentMon reports AllowsTearing=1 on its Independent Flip presents by design; a measurement-only mode (MLVAPP_PLAYBACK_UNPACED is honoured only in an automation run) that no user playback path reaches
